description: The IF EXISTS clause of ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN, through the SQL surface - DESCRIBE TABLE rows for column presence and SHOW TABLES cells (kind, comment, cluster_by) for the table properties a drop must preserve: dropping an existing column, a clean no-op on a missing one (idempotent, any number of times), the bare form erroring instead, qualified names, case-insensitive column matching, sequences of drops, both IF EXISTS clauses together, columns carrying constraints/DEFAULT/COLLATE, TRANSIENT and clustered and commented tables preserved, and drops mixed with ADD/RENAME COLUMN. Converted 1:1 from features/DropColumnIfExistsTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE test1 (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, email VARCHAR)
ALTER TABLE test1 DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS email
DESCRIBE TABLE test1
SELECT COUNT_IF("name" = 'ID'), COUNT_IF("name" = 'NAME'), COUNT_IF("name" = 'EMAIL') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
